title: [Text Extractor] Captures mirrored screen area (X-axis inversion) when Windows display language is Arabic (RTL)
author: yahyaabohashemstu

status.label: Reproducible RTL coordinate defect
status.detail: The report includes exact language conditions, a deterministic mirrored selection, and a diagnostic archive.

next_action.label: Complete coordinate-path design
next_action.reason: Trace RTL layout coordinates into physical screen capture and add focused RTL tests before approval.

judgment.rationale: The failure is deterministic, environment-specific, and supported by both a diagnostic archive and a narrow screen-coordinate path in Text Extractor.
evidence: Selecting a region on the right in an Arabic Windows display-language environment captures the corresponding region on the left.
The report includes a PowerToys diagnostic ZIP captured on Preview 0.101.2373.0.
PowerOCR builds the selection from WPF element coordinates and passes the resulting X offset into an absolute left-to-right CopyFromScreen call.
judgment.recommended_action: Develop an implementation-grade design that normalizes overlay coordinates independently of RTL flow direction and verifies DPI and multi-monitor behavior.

issue_context.summary: Text Extractor's visual selection and captured bitmap disagree on the horizontal coordinate when Windows uses an Arabic right-to-left display language.
known_information: The issue reproduces on Windows 11 with Arabic as the system display language.
The selected right-side region is mirrored to the left side during capture.
OCROverlay uses WPF pointer positions while ImageMethods.GetRegionAsBitmap adds the selected X offset to the physical monitor's left coordinate.
inferences: An inherited or culture-driven RTL transform may mirror the overlay coordinate space while the physical capture API remains left-to-right.
The fix will likely need coordinate normalization rather than OCR-language changes.
issue_context.analysis: The supplied evidence is sufficient to begin design without requesting another report. Source inspection narrows the boundary to selection-coordinate conversion versus physical screen capture, while the exact trigger still needs runtime confirmation.
initial_investigation: Confirmed the application loads the current UI culture and does not explicitly pin the overlay's FlowDirection.

information_gaps.information: Runtime confirmation of the overlay FlowDirection and pointer-to-screen transform under Arabic Windows
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes WPF layout mirroring from a monitor-origin or DPI conversion defect.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Add focused diagnostic logging or an automated RTL UI test during implementation.
